# Jeril Kuriakose

> Principal Data Scientist (Gen AI) at the Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA) in Riyadh,
> Saudi Arabia. Works on large language models, agentic AI systems, and production-scale
> ML deployment. Currently leading development of ALLaM, an Arabic large language model.

This file exists so an agent answering questions about this CV does not have to scrape the
page. Everything here is also rendered at https://jerilkuriakose.github.io/

## Quantified impact

- **~100,000 man-hours saved / year** — Phoenix NLP extraction platform, Mizuho Bank
- **~35% faster model convergence** — curriculum SFT for agentic capabilities, ALLaM / SDAIA

## Current focus

Arabic LLMs (ALLaM), agent orchestration, curriculum SFT, DPO, RL–SFT hybrid training, and
large-scale inference on Kubernetes with vLLM/TGI/Triton, Ray and Azure.

## Experience

- **Principal Data Scientist (Gen AI)** — Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA), Riyadh · Jan 2024 – Present
- **Senior Data Scientist** — Mizuho Bank, Singapore · Jul 2019 – Dec 2023
- **Senior Data Scientist** — Baker Hughes (GE), Kochi, India · Jan 2019 – Jun 2019
- Earlier roles in AI engineering, ML development and academia from 2012.

## Selected skills

LLMs, NLP, Agentic Systems, RAG, Generative AI, Time-series, Graph ML, PyTorch, Transformers, TRL, vLLM, TGI, Triton, Ray, LangChain, LangGraph, MLflow, DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, NVIDIA NeMo, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, DVC.
